fields.statement: At 9573ee0: go test ./internal/workflow -run TestRenderStepAddsNoCommitWhenClean -v passes for build and review; the test runs each workflow's real [step.render] command against a stub rhiza, gets one commit on a stale branch and an unchanged HEAD with clean .rhiza status on a rerun. Hands-on: built this commit's rhiza, cloned the already-rendered branch, ran the build and review render commands verbatim with it on PATH: 'Rendered 1498 files (0 written...)', both exit 0, HEAD stayed 9573ee0 and git status was empty. rhiza check on that clone passes; make fmt-check, vet and test pass. make self-check in the run checkout fails only on this run's uncommitted actor records (in-flight state the render step is meant to commit), not on the commit.
